decision.summary: Two temporally adjacent multi-axis events: (1) a sharp onset offset (~558–605) with sustained platform and only partial recovery in N; (2) a rapid reversal (~608–612) that partially restores components but does not reach original baseline. Neither event exhibits a clean, opposing return within the allowed context [520,645]; both are classified uncertain. No confirmed temporary offset interval.

intervals.observation: Coherent multi-axis drop (N ~−4, E ~−15, U ~−20 MAD) beginning sharply at index 558–560, sustained as a platform through 605; no opposing return observed within allowed context. N shows partial recovery after 605 but not full reversal; E and U remain offset. Return edge ambiguous/unobserved → uncertain.

Abrupt multi-sample reversal in all axes (N rising ~+3, E +12, U +15 MAD) from 608 to 612, restoring toward pre-offset levels; interior of reversal is coherent and multi-sample, but final level does not fully match pre-558 baseline (e.g., U remains ~−5 MAD at 612). Opposing return incomplete; status uncertain due to unconfirmed full restoration.
